page.content:
Studio that produces the streams, books, and The Legend of Vox Machina.

How Critical Role Productions connects

  • Topic: Critical Role — Critical Role Productions produces the streams and spin-off series.
  • Series: The Legend of Vox Machina — Critical Role Productions made The Legend of Vox Machina with Amazon.
  • Character: Marisha Ray — Marisha Ray is creative officer of Critical Role Productions.
  • Character: Travis Willingham — Travis Willingham is CEO of Critical Role Productions.

What is Critical Role Productions?

Critical Role Productions is the company around the cast — the Twitch and Beacon streams, the publishing line, and the deal that turned Campaign 1 into The Legend of Vox Machina.

Key threads lead to Critical Role, The Legend of Vox Machina, Marisha Ray and Travis Willingham.
